lead: `nvs_helper!` takes exactly one function per invocation, and a second one inside the block fails naming the *next* member's doc comment rather than yours.
body: An added member written above an existing one produces ``error: no rules expected `#` `` pointing at that member's `///` line, with nothing pointing at what you wrote; the macro's rule in `crates/nvs-runtime/src/abi.rs` is a single `fn`, no repetition. Close your block and open a new `nvs_runtime::nvs_helper! { … }`, which is why `cli.rs` has several invocations rather than one.
